mapper.update: update REP_ACCESS_LIST set status = '02',UPDATE_USER = #{updateUser, jdbcType=VARCHAR},UPDATE_TIME = sysdate where status = '01'
mapper.select: select tag.credit_tag_id from credit_tag_info tag left join sys_datadict_list dict on dict.item_code = tag.credit_type and dict.dict_code = 'LIMIT_TYPE' where 1 = 1 and dict.item_value = #{creditTypeName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and tag.credit_tag_name is null

select pflsh from ( select t.pflsh from credit_lines t where 1 = 1
and t.pflsh like 'TY%'
and t.pflsh like 'QY%'
and t.pflsh like 'ABS%'
order by t.pflsh desc ) where rownum = 1
